G0.detail: Harness is bit-deterministic: every per-region and global run-to-run meanAbsDiff is exactly 0.0 (15a-vs-15b, 14a-vs-14b). margin/noise is undefined as a ratio (denominator 0); enforced gates below quote absolute margins against this exact-zero floor, which satisfies the intent of margin/noise >= 1 (no sub-noise enforcement possible).

G1.detail: Physical swap at IOR 1.5 vs untouched MeshStandard: global meanAbsDiff 0.0128 (frac>0 px 0.001058, frac>1 LSB 0.001042, max 54), chin-region 0.0602 vs G0 noise 0.0 everywhere else. The swap alone changes 0.1% of pixels (specular-path rounding on the chin/jaw curve), i.e. NOT bit-identical. IOR 1.5->1.4 effect is 0.4977 global (~39x the swap effect), so attribution of the G3/G4 deltas to IOR stands, but the control is recorded as failed, not waved through. Downstream gates compare 1.5 vs 1.4 (independent of G1) and are measured.

G2.detail: skinOverrideApplied.ior reads back exactly 1.4 on body2 (mpfb_skin_adult_male_street_casual) and Aisha (mpfb_skin_ob_patient_aisha); 1.5 on both controls; every non-skin collectMaterialInventory entry identical 15-vs-14 on both subjects; skin type MeshPhysicalMaterial on all four, MeshStandardMaterial on the pre-change baseline.
